name: prepare-context
description: Agent-native context scrubber + compressor with savings receipts

scripts.build: npm run build -w @prepare-context/core && npm run build -w @prepare-context/sdk-ts && npm run build -w @prepare-context/server && npm run build -w @prepare-context/mcp
scripts.test: npm run build -w @prepare-context/core && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.demo: npm run build -w @prepare-context/core && npx tsx examples/demo.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @prepare-context/core && npm run dev -w @prepare-context/server
scripts.mcp: npm run build -w @prepare-context/core && npm run start -w @prepare-context/mcp
